backupUpgrade.title: Sandbox Upgrade Configuration
backupUpgrade.subtitle: Save Agent type-level upgrade commands; they are written into SandboxUpdateOps when an upgrade starts.
backupUpgrade.backupUnsupportedTitle: The current sandbox configuration cannot back up or restore data
backupUpgrade.backupWarning: The current SandboxSet is missing {{missing}} runtime, so it cannot mount /backup or run backup/restore. Update the SandboxSet before configuring upgrade commands or starting an upgrade. After the fix, only newly created instances will automatically get the backup mount; existing instances need to be recreated or manually patched.
backupUpgrade.riskTitle: Validate backup and restore with a test Sandbox before upgrading
backupUpgrade.riskText: Claimed Sandbox upgrades recreate the underlying Pod and do not preserve container Rootfs, memory, or IP. Only directories successfully written and restored by the pre-upgrade and post-upgrade commands can be retained. Confirm the /backup mount, backup script, and restore result on a test run before batch upgrades; unbacked data cannot be recovered after loss.
backupUpgrade.baseSelector: Base selector (derived from the SandboxSet by the backend when starting an upgrade)
backupUpgrade.commandHint: Confirm the actual data paths for this Agent and validate the pre-upgrade and post-upgrade commands with a test Sandbox first. The default example only covers OpenClaw's ~/.openclaw state directory. The pre-upgrade command writes a timestamped tgz, and the post-upgrade command restores the latest matching archive under /backup by default. To restore an older archive, change the post-upgrade command to reference the specific file.
backupUpgrade.preCommandDesc: Back up the current workspace before upgrade

validation.commandsRequired: Pre-upgrade and post-upgrade restore commands cannot be empty
